title: Juniper and the Hollow
author: Bram Fairweather
blurb: Ivo Thackeray, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
